description: Read-only approval and execution status for a direct trade or an existing-order cancel/modify request. Pass the actionId returned by place_trade, broker_orders(action="manage") or broker_orders(action=manage), or the deterministic singleTradeBotId/managerBotId single-trade-<actionId>. Use this tool for those approval requests even when no strategy or bot deployment exists. A broker order id or approval actionId is not a deploymentId; deployment telemetry describes deployed bots instead. Includes the Lambda request id, execution timings and sanitized errors. The tool verifies the action belongs to the signed-in user, then returns approval and one-shot execution state plus a fresh same-account broker-order observation when the order id is known. Check brokerOrderRead and singleTradeResultSource; a submission receipt alone cannot establish current fill state.
name: get_single_trade_status
title: Check trade or order-change status
